title: Existence of the cone 0⨯X over a compactly supported current
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, R ∈ ℝ and X ∈ D_m(ℝ^P) with spt X ⊆ B̄_R(0). Then there is C ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^P) (a cone 0⨯X over X) such that, for all ω ∈ D^{m+1}(ℝ^P) and ψ ∈ D^m(ℝ^P): if there is an open N ⊇ spt X with ψ(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 t^m ω(tx)(x, v) dt for all x ∈ N and v ∈ (ℝ^P)^m, then C(ω) = X(ψ). [Cone(X, C)]
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m), X.support ⊆ closedBall 0 R → ∃ C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1), (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m), (∃ N : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ v : Fin m → Eucl P, (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ m * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (t • x) (Fin.cons x v)) → C ω = X ψ)
